faqs.q: Which is the toughest government exam in India?
faqs.a: The UPSC Civil Services Exam is widely regarded as the toughest and most prestigious government exam in India. It leads to services such as the IAS, IPS and IFS, and needs long, dedicated preparation in general studies, current affairs and an optional subject.

faqs.q: Which government exams can I take after graduation?
faqs.a: Graduates can apply for exams such as the UPSC Civil Services Exam, SSC CGL, IBPS PO, RBI Grade B, state PSC exams and graduate-level RRB NTPC posts, provided they meet the age and other eligibility rules. Always check the latest official notification, as eligibility can differ by post.

faqs.q: Which government exams can I prepare for after 12th?
faqs.a: After Class 12, popular options include the NDA exam for the armed forces and the undergraduate-level posts in RRB NTPC for the railways. Eligibility, age limits and stream requirements vary, so read the official notification for each exam before you apply.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right government exam to prepare for?
faqs.a: Start with your interests and strengths, such as administration, banking, railways, defence, law or teaching, and check whether you meet the education and age criteria. Then compare the syllabus and selection stages, pick one main exam and follow a consistent study plan while keeping up with current affairs.
